anomalies.observed: On the root sheet, the VCC arrow feeds capacitor symbols C1-C4 in series into the STM32L476RGT6 supply pins (VBAT/VDD/VDD/VDD). The capacitor bodies are between VCC and the MCU supply pins and have no shown connection to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the MCU supply pins on the VCC rail and describes C2/C3/C4 etc. as VCC-GND local bypass capacitors. Sound practice requires VDD/VBAT pins tied directly to VCC with decoupling capacitors from those pins to GND, not capacitors inserted in the DC power path.

evidence.quote: Root sheet PCB.kicad_sch: VCC arrow connected to C1, C2, C3, C4 capacitor symbols whose lower terminals connect to U2 VBAT/VDD/VDD/VDD pins; no GND symbol on those capacitor terminals.
C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)

anomalies.impact: The DC supply path to the MCU core/supply pins is blocked by capacitors, so the MCU may not power up or start reliably.

anomalies.observed: In the Capacitive Touch Button block, C2 (22 nF) is connected from GND to NET0011, and R4 (1 kΩ) is connected from the same node to A3 BTN. NET0011 and NET0005 are both shown attached to the left terminal of R4; on the root sheet NET0005 is PB5 and NET0011 is PB7, so the electrode drive net and the TSC sampling-capacitor net are merged.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires TSC_G2_IO2 (PB5) to drive the touch electrode through a 1 kΩ series resistor, while TSC_G2_IO4 (PB7) is only the sampling-capacitor pin with a 22 nF capacitor to GND. These must remain separate nets.

evidence.quote: Touch sheet: C2 22n to GND, R4 1k to A3 BTN, with labels NET0011 and NET0005 on the R4 input node; root sheet labels PB5 as NET0005 and PB7 as NET0011.
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN"; TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)

anomalies.impact: The TSC sampling capacitor is tied to the electrode drive line, preventing proper capacitive-touch sensing and loading the PB5/PB7 pins.

parsed.summary: The drawing supports two likely anomalies: MCU supply pins are coupled through capacitors instead of being directly powered with bypass caps to ground, and the touch electrode and TSC sampling-capacitor nets appear to be bridged together.
